feature1.prompt: The issue is that using limit_choices_to on a ForeignKey can render duplicate options in the formfield. When a Q object is passed as limit_choices_to for a ForeignKey field that involves a join, it may result in duplicate entries being displayed. The fix should correct the filtering logic so that only a unique set of options appears. After the change, the formfield should only show non‐duplicate options based on the criteria supplied.
feature1.hint_texts: This feature involves modifying the apply_limit_choices_to_to_formfield function to prevent duplicate options. The implementation should import and utilize Exists, OuterRef, and Q to refine the queryset filtering logic. The function must convert the limit_choices_to parameter to a Q object if necessary and append an additional filter condition (e.g. Q(pk=OuterRef('pk'))). This change will ensure that the filtered queryset does not return any duplicate entries.

The solution should guarantee that the formfield shows a unique set of options by enforcing stricter filtering rules. This feature focuses on verifying that the changes produce the expected behavior without duplicate options in the rendered form.

Ensure that the tests in the test suite accurately reflect the new behavior and that any modifications to the related test files are coordinated with the function changes.
